attempts.prompt:
Create ONE corrected south-facing idle character sprite for a 2D overhead RPG.
REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the user's anatomy and directional sprite guide. Its SECOND ROW, front/south-facing figures, is the main direction/stance guide. Use relaxed planted feet and believable joints.
Image 2 is ONLY the existing character's identity, costume, palette and painterly medium reference. Its upright front-view camera is WRONG and must NOT be preserved.

CAMERA IS THE PRIMARY CORRECTION: fixed orthographic game camera positioned high above and south of the character, tilted DOWN about 50 degrees below the horizon. He stands vertically on a horizontal floor and faces due SOUTH, toward the bottom edge of the sprite. He looks straight ahead horizontally into the game world, NOT up into the camera. Do not fake the viewpoint by bowing his neck. Show the broad TOP surface of his brown hair/crown and both shoulders; show top planes of pauldron, scarf opening, forearms, gloves and boot vamps. Compress projected chest, abdomen, thighs and shins consistently according to this downward viewing angle. Head overlaps part of upper chest. The face is a small lower/front plane under the hair, with eyebrows/eyes partly below the fringe; there is no large portrait-like face staring at viewer. No visible underside of chin or soles. Keep straight spine and relaxed neck, with normal limb lengths in 3D projected into a foreshortened sprite.

One young swordsman, same short tousled brown hair, cream scarf, brown leather tunic with split skirt, charcoal pants, brown boots/gloves/bracers. Steel pauldron with two gold rivets on LEFT OF IMAGE, leather pouch LEFT OF IMAGE. Sword held by glove on RIGHT OF IMAGE and lowered beside body, blade points toward bottom-right, entire sword visible. Balanced neutral stance with both feet firmly planted at equal depth, shoulder-width apart. Arms relaxed and readable beside torso.

Warm matte hand-painted 2D game sprite, soft simplified color masses, restrained outline, preserve original brown/cream/steel palette. No photorealism, no 3D-render finish. Whole figure including sword, large individual source image, generous transparent margin, highest native resolution, a single centered pose only. Actual transparent background without a baked floor, glow, shadow, text, UI, comparison panel or animation frames.

Correct ONLY the camera projection of the supplied swordsman illustration. The current image wrongly combines an overhead head with a nearly front-view torso and legs. Redraw the WHOLE figure coherently from a much higher, truly overhead orthographic game camera, about 65 degrees DOWN from horizontal. Imagine a camera on a ceiling, looking down at someone standing erect below. He faces south, the bottom edge of image, head and spine upright, never bowing. In projection, crown and shoulder tops dominate; shoulders are seen from above as broad depth planes; face is only a thin lower strip under bangs; torso front is strongly shortened and partially hidden behind head; thighs and shins project much shorter and foreshortened, boots show almost entirely TOP surfaces. Projected character height should become about 2.8 crown-widths, achieved by camera projection, not a baby body or changed anatomy. Hands appear at the sides of foreshortened hips. Do not preserve the current long vertically displayed chest, front-facing shins, full tall face or eye contact. Feet stay planted and separated at equal depth; clear believable overlap order head over shoulders over torso over legs. Maintain the same brown hair, cream scarf, brown leather armor, charcoal trousers, brown gloves/boots, steel pauldron and pouch on screen left, lowered sword in screen-right glove. Preserve warm matte painted 2D style and palette. ONE whole centered character with the entire sword, transparent background, no shadows, no text, no grid, no comparison.
